title: [Main] Consistent Error Posting GST Distribution Reversal
summary: GST Distribution Reversal posting now correctly handles rounding differences when distributed GST amounts contain decimals, applying the rounding adjustment to the first matching component line credit amount.
key_points: GST amounts are rounded per component line during distribution, creating rounding differences
Normal distributions apply rounding difference to the debit amount, but reversals did not
Reversals failed because total credit amounts differed from original GST amount by the rounding difference
Solution applies the same rounding logic to reversals by adding the difference to the first matching component line credit amount
Whole amount reversals were not affected and continue to work
quote: Posting a GST Distribution Reversal fails with an error when the distributed GST amounts have decimals.
